title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 33
description: Ten questions on Numbers 33: the journeys of Israel from Rameses to the plains of Moab.

questions.text: Who wrote down the starting points of Israel's journeys?
questions.explanation: Moses wrote the starting points of their journeys by the commandment of Yahweh.

questions.text: When did Israel travel from Rameses?
questions.explanation: They traveled from Rameses on the fifteenth day of the first month, the next day after the Passover.

answers.text: On the tenth day of the seventh month

questions.text: What were the Egyptians doing while Israel went out?
questions.explanation: The Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom Yahweh had struck among them.

questions.text: What was at Elim, where Israel encamped?
questions.explanation: In Elim there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees.

answers.text: Seven wells and twelve palm trees
A river and a forest of cedars
Twelve springs and seventy palm trees
Bitter water and a single tree

questions.explanation: At Rephidim there was no water for the people to drink.

answers.text: Water for the people to drink

questions.text: On which mountain did Aaron the priest die?
questions.explanation: Aaron went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of Yahweh and died there.

questions.text: How old was Aaron when he died?
questions.explanation: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.

questions.text: Who heard of the coming of the children of Israel?
questions.explanation: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of their coming.

questions.text: Where did Israel encamp after traveling from the mountains of Abarim?
questions.explanation: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

questions.text: What would the inhabitants they let remain in the land be like?
questions.explanation: Those they let remain would be like pricks in their eyes and thorns in their sides.

answers.text: Stones in their shoes and dust in their mouths
Snakes in their tents and wolves in their fields
Weeds in their fields and rust on their swords
Pricks in their eyes and thorns in their sides
